import_jobs_running_holds_lease.name: import_jobs_running_holds_lease
import_jobs_running_holds_lease.value: "import_jobs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("import_jobs"."run_token" IS NOT NULL AND "import_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

import_rows_accepted_is_complete.name: import_rows_accepted_is_complete
import_rows_accepted_is_complete.value:
"import_rows"."status" <> 'accepted' OR (
        "import_rows"."title" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("import_rows"."title") <> ''
        AND "import_rows"."kind" IS NOT NULL
        AND "import_rows"."price_minor" IS NOT NULL
        AND "import_rows"."currency" IS NOT NULL
      )

import_rows_accepted_service_has_terms.name: import_rows_accepted_service_has_terms
import_rows_accepted_service_has_terms.value:
"import_rows"."status" <> 'accepted' OR "import_rows"."kind" <> 'service' OR (
        "import_rows"."service_duration_minutes" IS NOT NULL
        AND "import_rows"."deposit_minor" IS NOT NULL
        AND "import_rows"."deposit_minor" <= "import_rows"."price_minor"
      )

import_rows_accepted_product_has_no_serv.name: import_rows_accepted_product_has_no_service_terms

inventory_stock_quantities.name: inventory_stock_quantities
inventory_stock_quantities.value:
("inventory_stock"."mode" = 'tracked' AND "inventory_stock"."on_hand" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_stock"."on_hand" >= "inventory_stock"."reserved" AND "inventory_stock"."on_hand" <= 1000000) OR
        ("inventory_stock"."mode" = 'untracked' AND "inventory_stock"."on_hand" IS NULL AND "inventory_stock"."reserved" = 0)

paypal_merchant_connections_one_active_p.name: paypal_merchant_connections_one_active_per_shop
paypal_merchant_connections_one_active_p.where: "paypal_merchant_connections"."status" IN ('pending', 'ready') OR ("paypal_merchant_connections"."status" = 'error' AND ("paypal_merchant_connections"."error_code" = 'status_unavailable' OR "paypal_merchant_connections"."referral_self_url" IS NOT NULL))

paypal_merchant_connections_one_active_s.name: paypal_merchant_connections_one_active_seller
paypal_merchant_connections_one_active_s.where: "paypal_merchant_connections"."seller_merchant_id" IS NOT NULL AND ("paypal_merchant_connections"."status" IN ('pending', 'ready') OR ("paypal_merchant_connections"."status" = 'error' AND ("paypal_merchant_connections"."error_code" = 'status_unavailable' OR "paypal_merchant_connections"."referral_self_url" IS NOT NULL)))

product_search_terms_indexed_is_complete.name: product_search_terms_indexed_is_complete
product_search_terms_indexed_is_complete.value:
"product_search_terms"."status" <> 'indexed' OR (
        "product_search_terms"."source_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "product_search_terms"."model" IS NOT NULL
        AND "product_search_terms"."prompt_version" IS NOT NULL
        AND "product_search_terms"."indexed_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

products_synced_requires_record.name: products_synced_requires_record
products_synced_requires_record.value: "products"."paypal_sync_status" <> 'synced' OR ("products"."paypal_product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."paypal_synced_at" IS NOT NULL)

products_service_fields_only_on_services.name: products_service_fields_only_on_services
products_service_fields_only_on_services.value: "products"."kind" = 'service' OR ("products"."service_duration_minutes" IS NULL AND "products"."deposit_minor" IS NULL)

products_published_service_requires_term.name: products_published_service_requires_terms
products_published_service_requires_term.value: "products"."kind" <> 'service' OR "products"."status" <> 'published' OR ("products"."service_duration_minutes" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."deposit_minor" IS NOT NULL)

seller_agent_grants_scope.name: seller_agent_grants_scope
seller_agent_grants_scope.value:
("seller_agent_grants"."shop_id" IS NULL AND "seller_agent_grants"."scopes" = ARRAY['create_shop']::text[]) OR
        ("seller_agent_grants"."shop_id" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("seller_agent_grants"."scopes") > 0 AND
         "seller_agent_grants"."scopes" <@ ARRAY['read_shop', 'manage_catalog', 'manage_inventory', 'connect_paypal']::text[])

seller_agent_grants_paypal_consent.name: seller_agent_grants_paypal_consent
seller_agent_grants_paypal_consent.value: NOT ('connect_paypal' = ANY("seller_agent_grants"."scopes")) OR "seller_agent_grants"."share_data_consent_at" IS NOT NULL

seller_identity_operations_result_shape.name: seller_identity_operations_result_shape
seller_identity_operations_result_shape.value:
("seller_identity_operations"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "seller_identity_operations"."shop_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("seller_identity_operations"."operation" = 'register_owner' AND "seller_identity_operations"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seller_identity_operations"."shop_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("seller_identity_operations"."operation" IN ('register_owner_shop', 'create_shop') AND "seller_identity_operations"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seller_identity_operations"."shop_id" IS NOT NULL)

seller_owners_password_hash_format.name: seller_owners_password_hash_format
seller_owners_password_hash_format.value:
"seller_owners"."password_hash" IS NULL OR (split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 1) = 'scrypt' AND
        split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 2) = '16384' AND
        split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 3) = '8' AND
        split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 4) = '1' AND
        split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 5) ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$' AND
        split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 6) ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$' AND
        split_part("seller_owners"."password_hash", '$', 7) = '')

webhook_receipts_order_requires_shop.name: webhook_receipts_order_requires_shop
webhook_receipts_order_requires_shop.value: "webhook_receipts"."order_id" IS NULL OR "webhook_receipts"."shop_id" IS NOT NULL
